description: Compare all GPUs of one node side by side: current state, utilization, thermals, throttling and health per GPU. Companion to the Nvidia GPU Metrics dashboard (single-GPU detail, click a GPU in the table to drill down). Shows physical GPUs as reported by nvidia-smi, MIG instances are not broken out: rows are the parent GPUs, whose utilization is not reported in MIG mode and shows n/a. Based on the prometheus metrics from github.com/utkuozdemir/nvidia_gpu_exporter

panels.description: Every selected GPU on this node with its current state. Click a GPU name to open it in the single-GPU detail dashboard. Health columns show n/a when the driver does not report the metric.

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(label_join(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}, "ni", " #", "name", "index"), "us", "($1)", "uuid", "^(........).*"), "gpu_label", " ", "ni", "us")
(nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)

(nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} / nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)
(nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)

(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} / ((nvidia_smi_enforced_power_limit_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_power_limit_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_power_default_limit_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) > 0)) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)
(nvidia_smi_pstate{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)

(sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_power_cap{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0))

(sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_ecc_errors_uncorrected_aggregate_total{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or sum by(uuid, instance, job) ({__name__=~"nvidia_smi_ecc_errors_uncorrected_aggregate_.+", uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)
(nvidia_smi_gpu_recovery_action{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0 - 1)

panels.title: GPUs

panels.description: GPU utilization over time, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: GPU Utilization %

panels.description: How busy the memory controller is. Allocation is the VRAM Allocated panel.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_utilization_memory_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Memory Activity %

panels.description: Share of VRAM allocated over time, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} / nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: VRAM Allocated %

panels.description: Absolute VRAM allocated over time, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: VRAM Allocated

panels.description: Core temperature over time, one series per selected GPU. The red line marks 80 °C.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Temperature

panels.description: Power draw over time, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Power Draw

panels.description: Passively cooled cards report no fan speed and are absent here.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_fan_speed_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Fan Speed %

panels.description: Fraction of the enforced power limit currently drawn by each selected GPU. Sustained operation near 100% alongside coarse GPU utilization indicates true compute saturation.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} / (nvidia_smi_enforced_power_limit_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_power_limit_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_power_default_limit_watts{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Power Limit Utilization %

panels.description: Fraction of time each selected GPU's clocks were throttled by the software power cap over the rate window. Requires driver 550+ (clocks_event_reasons_counters.sw_power_cap).

targets.expr: (rate(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_counters_sw_power_cap_seconds{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Power Cap Throttling %

panels.description: How many performance-limiting throttle reasons are active per GPU (SW power cap, SW thermal, HW thermal, HW power brake). The per-reason breakdown lives in the GPU detail dashboard.

targets.expr: ((sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_power_cap{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0))) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Throttling (history)

panels.description: Performance state per GPU. Lower P means busier, deep blue = max performance.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_pstate{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: P-State (history)

panels.description: Current graphics clock over time, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_clocks_current_graphics_clock_hz{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Graphics Clock

panels.description: Current memory clock over time, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_clocks_current_memory_clock_hz{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Memory Clock

panels.description: Percent of time over the past sample period during which one or more kernels was executing on the Encoder Engine, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_utilization_encoder_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Encoder Utilization %

panels.description: Percent of time over the past sample period during which one or more kernels was executing on the Decoder Engine, one series per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_utilization_decoder_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Decoder Utilization %

panels.description: Number of active encoder sessions per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_encoder_stats_session_count{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Encoder Sessions

panels.description: Average FPS across active encoder sessions per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_encoder_stats_average_fps{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Encoder Average FPS

panels.description: Average encode latency in microseconds across active encoder sessions per selected GPU.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_encoder_stats_average_latency{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Encoder Average Latency

panels.description: Processes with a compute or graphics context across all selected GPUs on this node, with workload identity, engine utilization (SM, memory bandwidth, video encoder, video decoder), used memory, and share of that GPU's total VRAM. Click a GPU name to open it in the single-GPU detail dashboard. Requires --collect.compute-apps and/or --collect.graphics-apps; utilization requires the nvml or demo backend on a non-MIG GPU.

targets.expr: (label_replace(nvidia_smi_compute_app_used_memory_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_compute_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0), "type", "compute", "", "") or label_replace(nvidia_smi_graphics_app_used_memory_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_graphics_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0), "type", "graphics", "", "")) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

((label_replace(nvidia_smi_compute_app_used_memory_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_compute_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0), "type", "compute", "", "") or label_replace(nvidia_smi_graphics_app_used_memory_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_graphics_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0), "type", "graphics", "", "")) / on(uuid) group_left() nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

(label_replace(nvidia_smi_compute_app_sm_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_compute_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "compute", "", "") or label_replace(nvidia_smi_graphics_app_sm_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_graphics_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "graphics", "", "")) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

(label_replace(nvidia_smi_compute_app_memory_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_compute_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "compute", "", "") or label_replace(nvidia_smi_graphics_app_memory_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_graphics_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "graphics", "", "")) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

(label_replace(nvidia_smi_compute_app_encoder_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_compute_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "compute", "", "") or label_replace(nvidia_smi_graphics_app_encoder_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_graphics_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "graphics", "", "")) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

(label_replace(nvidia_smi_compute_app_decoder_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_compute_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "compute", "", "") or label_replace(nvidia_smi_graphics_app_decoder_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or (nvidia_smi_graphics_app_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} * 0 - 1), "type", "graphics", "", "")) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

panels.title: GPU Processes

panels.description: Per-process SM (3D/compute) utilization over time across all selected GPUs on this node. Served by the nvml and demo backends on non-MIG GPUs.

targets.expr: max by (uuid, pid, process_name) (nvidia_smi_compute_app_sm_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_graphics_app_sm_utilization_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Process SM Utilization

panels.description: GPU memory per process over time across all selected GPUs, stacked. Processes appear and disappear as they open and close compute or graphics contexts. Empty when --collect.compute-apps and --collect.graphics-apps are off or the platform reports no per-process memory.

targets.expr: max by (uuid, pid, process_name) (nvidia_smi_compute_app_used_memory_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_graphics_app_used_memory_bytes{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Process Memory Over Time

panels.description: Health of the compute process collection on the selected node. OK means the last collection succeeded, so an empty table really means no compute processes. Failing means the exporter could not deliver compute process data. Off means the exporter runs without --collect.compute-apps.

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_compute_apps_last_collect_success{instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Compute Collection

panels.description: Health of the graphics process collection on the selected node. OK means the last collection succeeded, so an empty table really means no graphics processes. Failing means the exporter could not deliver graphics process data. Off means the exporter runs without --collect.graphics-apps (needs the nvml or demo backend).

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_graphics_apps_last_collect_success{instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Graphics Collection

panels.description: Uncorrected ECC errors per GPU (aggregate). Cards without ECC report nothing.

targets.expr: (sum by(uuid, instance, job) (nvidia_smi_ecc_errors_uncorrected_aggregate_total{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or sum by(uuid, instance, job) ({__name__=~"nvidia_smi_ecc_errors_uncorrected_aggregate_.+", uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: ECC Errors (uncorrected)

panels.description: Recommended recovery action per GPU. Only recent datacenter drivers report this.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_gpu_recovery_action{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Recovery Action (history)

panels.description: Power averaged from the driver's cumulative energy counter, smoother and more complete than the sampled power draw. Served only by the nvml and demo backends; absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: (rate(nvidia_smi_energy_joules_total{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: Power Draw (energy counter)

panels.description: PCIe transmit throughput per GPU, sampled by the driver over 20ms windows. Requires --collect.pcie-throughput on the nvml backend. Served only by the nvml and demo backends; absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_pcie_throughput_tx_bytes_per_second{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: PCIe TX

panels.description: PCIe receive throughput per GPU, sampled by the driver over 20ms windows. Requires --collect.pcie-throughput on the nvml backend. Served only by the nvml and demo backends; absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_pcie_throughput_rx_bytes_per_second{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: PCIe RX

panels.description: Cumulative XID errors per GPU since the exporter started (earlier history cannot be replayed, so a restart resets the counts). Flat zero is healthy. Do not alert on increase() of this counter: a series' first event is invisible to it, alert on the last-timestamp metric instead (see METRICS.md). Served only by the nvml and demo backends; absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: (sum by (uuid) (nvidia_smi_xid_errors_total{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) or (((max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * 0) and on() (max(nvidia_smi_xid_watcher_enabled{instance="$node", job="$job"}) == 1)) or (sum by (uuid) (nvidia_smi_xid_errors_total{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) unless on(uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"})

panels.title: XID Errors (since exporter start)
Last XID per GPU
panels.description: Seconds since each GPU last raised each XID code. 'Never' means no errors since the exporter started. This is the signal to alert on: unlike increase() on the error counter, it also sees each series' first event (see METRICS.md). Served only by the nvml and demo backends, absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: (time() - max by (uuid, xid) (nvidia_smi_xid_last_timestamp_seconds{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) or ((((max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * 0 - 1) and on() (max(nvidia_smi_xid_watcher_enabled{instance="$node", job="$job"}) == 1)) unless on(uuid) nvidia_smi_xid_last_timestamp_seconds{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) or ((time() - max by (uuid, xid) (nvidia_smi_xid_last_timestamp_seconds{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"})) unless on(uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"})

panels.title: MIG Instances
panels.description: The node's MIG partitions: one row per GPU instance (compute instances sharing it are collapsed, like the per-instance metrics). Empty when no GPU on the node is partitioned. Served only by the nvml and demo backends; absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: (max by (uuid, gpu_instance_id, profile) (nvidia_smi_mig_info{instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) (max by (uuid, index, name) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}))

panels.description: SM activity per MIG GPU instance across partitioned GPUs, and per whole GPU across unpartitioned GPUs. Empty when no GPU supports GPM, and the first collection serves nothing because sampling needs a pair of collections. Served only by the nvml and demo backends, absent under the default exec backend.

targets.expr: ((nvidia_smi_mig_sm_activity_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid, gpu_instance_id) group_left(profile) (max by (uuid, gpu_instance_id, profile) (label_replace(nvidia_smi_mig_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "profile", "$1", "profile", "^[0-9]+c\\.(.*)$")))) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}
(nvidia_smi_sm_activity_ratio{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info{uuid=~"$gpu", instance="$node", job="$job"}

panels.title: SM Activity (GPM)
MIG Memory Used
panels.description: Framebuffer memory used per MIG GPU instance (memory is a GPU-instance-level resource, shared by its compute instances). Served only by the nvml and demo backends; absent under the default exec backend.
